ledger_events.query: Inspect both GeoPackage inputs, identify their layers, geometry types, CRS, and relevant attribute fields. Confirm which layer contains hospitals and which contains Centre County census tracts, and report any unique tract identifier fields.

Retrieve and inspect the hospital GeoPackage that was not returned previously. Identify its layer name, geometry type, CRS, and relevant hospital identifier/name fields. Also inspect the retrieved tract dataset for its layer name and unique tract identifier field if not already determined.
Retrieve ONLY the hospital input file and return the resulting artifact path. The required source is fx_hospitals_utm.gpkg; do not substitute or return the tract file.

Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join/count to count hospital features within each census tract in Centre County. Use the input files fx_hospitals_utm.gpkg and fx_tracts_centre_utm.gpkg (the hospital dataset is the point layer and the tract dataset is the polygon layer). Preserve all tract attributes, add a hospital count field (e.g., hospital_count), and write the resulting tract layer to a new GeoPackage. Return the output artifact path, layer name, and a brief validation summary including total hospitals counted and tract count.

Validate the hospital-within-tract result using the source layers fx_hospitals_utm.gpkg and fx_tracts_centre_utm.gpkg. Produce a complete tract-level output including every census tract (zero counts included), with a hospital_count field calculated by point-in-polygon containment. Return the output GeoPackage artifact path, layer name, number of tracts, total hospitals assigned, and any hospitals falling outside tracts.
